# Template creation workflow

Version 0.3.1 · Owner: Ingrid Witherell, MPH · Standing: observed · Pilot: IB-FIRST

Applies to: Every report base in _template structure › report-base-library. Building blocks are written to `<LABEL> <title>/building-blocks/`.

Step names marked † are minted and wait for a smart name.

## Steps

| Step | Level | Standing | Writes | Check | Sets off |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| **Derive the spine †** | report | observed | <LABEL>.spine.md | — | — |
| **Gather existing notes †** | report | observed | <LABEL>.notes.md | — | — |
| **Study through Rhizome** | report | observed | <LABEL>.study.md; <LABEL>.rhizome-report.md | — | attach-rhizome-report-to-notion-row, file-new-guidance |
| **Point to guidance †** | report | observed | <LABEL>.guidance.md | — | update-guidance-map |
| **Map sections to components** | report | observed | <LABEL>.components.md | Every section of the spine has a component, or its gap is recorded as a component requested | — |
| **Route report-unique slots** | report | observed | <LABEL>.slots.md | No slot without a route, and every route carries the record that route requires | — |
| **Set placement** | report | observed | <LABEL>.placement.md | Every part has a placement | — |
| **Set alteration** | report | observed | <LABEL>.alteration.md | Every part names its lock and what may be altered | — |
| **Declare overlays** | report | observed | <LABEL>.overlays.md | Every overlay names its switch, and every part it adds carries a route, a placement and a lock | open-overlay-tracker-row |
| **Assemble the base** | report | observed | <LABEL>.base.md | The counts of component pointers, components requested, local slots and overlay slots match the building blocks | update-base-map-status |
| **Curate the base** | report | observed | — | — | — |
| **Rule and publish** | report | observed | <LABEL>.base.md (becomes a pointer) | — | commit-base-to-git, update-base-map-status, index-new-files |
| **Tag stage and kind** | report | ruled | — | — | apply-metatags, index-new-files |

## What each step does

### Derive the spine

Derives the outline of the governed document from the governing source, read from inside the guidance body, never from its contents page.

Rulings applied:

- `read-structure-from-guidance-body` — A governed document's structure is read from inside the guidance body, never from its contents page. (Ingrid, 2026-09-20)

Evidence: IB-FIRST.spine.md (Box 2541844547568), run 2026-10-21.

### Gather existing notes

Searches EH OS for notes whose subject is the base and lists them as a pointer file, each with its standing. Notes stay where they are.

Rulings applied:

- `standing-ruled-proposed-observed` — Ruled binds and is carried as settled. Proposed and observed enter as material for curation, never as settled. (observed)
- `pointers-not-copies` — Each document and building block is held in one place. Other places hold a pointer, never a copy. (observed)

Evidence: IB-FIRST.notes.md (Box 2541836277526), run 2026-10-21.

### Study through Rhizome

Studies the base's sources through Rhizome AI, saves the report unedited, and holds every difference for Ingrid's ruling. Unfiled sources found here are filed in guidance-library before they can bind.

Rulings applied:

- `research-through-rhizome` — Research is done through Rhizome AI. (Ingrid, 2026-10-23)
- `rhizome-binds-after-validation` — Rhizome searches bind only once Ingrid validates them. (Ingrid, 2026-10-21)
- `templates-from-filed-sources-only` — Templates are built from source documents filed in guidance-library, never from memory. A finding resting on an unfiled source stays study material. (observed)
- `conflicts-ingrid-decides` — Where filed documents conflict, Ingrid decides. (Ingrid, 2026-10-21)

Evidence: IB-FIRST.study.md (Box 2541840707636), run 2026-10-21.

### Point to guidance

Writes the pointer file naming the guidance-library documents the base uses, each with its role. Holds no copy.

Rulings applied:

- `pointers-not-copies` — Each document and building block is held in one place. Other places hold a pointer, never a copy. (observed)
- `scope-is-ingrids-ruling` — The regions a guidance document applies to are Ingrid's ruling for each document, never assumed from the issuer. Scope stays blank until she rules. (Ingrid, 2026-10-21)
- `draft-marker-never-changes-value` — * marks draft guidance. The marker never changes a value. (observed)

Evidence: IB-FIRST.guidance.md (Box 2541470226183), run 2026-10-21.

### Map sections to components

Maps each spine section to an existing shared component, or records the gap as a component requested.

Rulings applied:

- `templates-from-filed-sources-only` — Templates are built from source documents filed in guidance-library, never from memory. A finding resting on an unfiled source stays study material. (observed)
- `shared-components-index-only` — Shared Components serve only as an index of what a part is about. A component is marked source-confirmed once rebuilt from a filed source. (Ingrid, 2026-10-21)

Evidence: IB-FIRST.components.md (Box 2542068906936), run 2026-10-21.

### Route report-unique slots

Gives every slot unique to the base a route (decision, controlled language, algorithm or binding) and the record that route requires.

Rulings applied:

- `route-ruled-only-if-it-cites-a-ruling` — A route whose record cites a ruling by Ingrid is ruled. Every other route is proposed. (Ingrid, 2026-10-22)

Evidence: IB-FIRST.slots.md (Box 2542099533107), run 2026-10-22.

### Set placement

Sets every part as pinned to its source section or flexible, with where a flexible part may move.

Rulings applied:

- `placement-default-pinned` — Every part is pinned to its source section unless ruled flexible. (Ingrid, 2026-10-22)
- `flexible-moves-recorded` — Each move of a flexible part is recorded. (Ingrid, 2026-10-21)

Evidence: IB-FIRST.placement.md (Box 2542146135948), run 2026-10-22.

### Set alteration

Sets the lock on every part and what may be altered in it.

Rulings applied:

- `alteration-default-nothing` — By default nothing can be altered; alteration is defined section by section. (Ingrid, 2026-10-21)

Evidence: IB-FIRST.alteration.md (Box 2542152013935), run 2026-10-22.

### Declare overlays

Declares the overlays the base takes, each with its switch; every part an overlay adds carries a route, a placement and a lock.

Rulings applied:

- `overlays-may-add` — Overlays may prune an ICH spine and may add content within an existing section. A structure whose sections differ from the spine needs its own base. (Ingrid, 2026-10-22)
- `modality-is-an-overlay` — The modality is an overlay; it never becomes a base, and folder names carry no modality. (Ingrid, 2026-10-21)

Evidence: IB-FIRST.overlays.md (Box 2542161340288), run 2026-10-22.

### Assemble the base

Replaces the placeholder with the assembled base: each section names its source passage, component pointer, placement, lock and local slots, and the counts reconcile with the building blocks.

Rulings applied:

- `base-held-in-box-until-rule-and-publish` — A base is held in Box while it is drafted and committed to git at "Rule and publish", when the Box file becomes a pointer. Box keeps earlier versions. (Ingrid, 2026-10-22)

Evidence: IB-FIRST.base.md (Box 2540131330871), run 2026-10-22.

### Curate the base

Settles draft instructions the base rests on. Named in IB-FIRST.slots.md; not yet run.

Evidence: IB-FIRST.slots.md (Box 2542099533107), run not yet run.

### Rule and publish

Confirms the routes and locks still proposed, commits the base to git, and turns the Box file into a pointer. Not yet run.

Rulings applied:

- `base-held-in-box-until-rule-and-publish` — A base is held in Box while it is drafted and committed to git at "Rule and publish", when the Box file becomes a pointer. Box keeps earlier versions. (Ingrid, 2026-10-22)
- `route-ruled-only-if-it-cites-a-ruling` — A route whose record cites a ruling by Ingrid is ruled. Every other route is proposed. (Ingrid, 2026-10-22)

Evidence: IB-FIRST.base.md (Box 2540131330871), run not yet run.

### Tag stage and kind

Tags every part with its stage and kind. Last step of the workflow. Not yet run.

Rulings applied:

- `tag-stage-and-kind-at-end` — The step "Tag stage and kind" is the last step of the workflow. (Ingrid, 2026-10-22)

Evidence: IB-FIRST.placement.md (Box 2542146135948), run not yet run.
